derivative.description: Official TouchDesigner documentation — 25,887 chunks, 674 operators. Scraped from docs.derivative.ca.

popx.description: POPx GPU-accelerated operators — 480 chunks, 59 operators. Scraped from popsextension.com.

paketa12.description: 177 TouchDesigner tutorials by paketa12 — GPU-texture-as-compute, UV math, from-scratch simulations, Voronoi/packing, GLSL, feedback loops. No remote DB yet — build locally with scripts/build_tutorial_brain.py.
paketa12.install_notes: Local-build brain. Clone transcripts with yt-dlp, then run `uv run python scripts/build_tutorial_brain.py --config data/brains/paketa12.yaml`. `npx tdpilot brains add paketa12` will refuse to activate until `runtime_db` exists on disk.
